title: Emerald Saver vs Green Account (savings): What is the difference?
summary: This document compares Emerald Saver (savings) and Green Account (savings) by focusing on statement delivery and environmental impact reporting. Emerald Saver requires paperless statements and provides environmental impact reporting monthly; for mailed statements or different reporting cadence, it directs you to review Green Account terms.
